svg.text: Adafruit Terminal Block Breakout FeatherWing with Adafruit Feather HUZZAH ESP8266
Default channel map. Terminals are numbered from the 3v3 end of each edge. Generated by tools/render_pinout.py.

g.text: plugs in here, USB end towards the left
GPIO15: 4.7 kΩ boot pull-down, not usable
[13] = position with no silkscreen label (count from the 3v3 end)
= SCK B11: same GPIO as that terminal, leave it free
Common ground: wire T3/T4/B4 (GND) to J7-1 or J8-1
Each TinyG input: 2.7 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V and 0.22 µF to GND
(v8h schematic), so edges under about 1 ms are smoothed.
